correctness.rationale: The coprime bidegree-(m,2) forms P=-A W0 W1 and Q=A(W1^2-W0^2)+B W0 W1 have base locus only at W=0,infinity over each simple real projective root of A. At each of the 2m points, Q=0 is locally smooth and P restricted to it vanishes to exact order 2. Their binary resultant is -A^4, verified formally by symbolic Sylvester determinant. Cayley transformations and invertible range normalization preserve the local intersection schemes, producing full torus saturation 4m. The nonconstant rational Herglotz pole lemma and rational-inner passage are applied with exact hypotheses. The external source proves measure extremality.

value.rationale: The result establishes a complete natural infinite family of saturated scattering-stable polynomials associated with genuinely extreme bidisk positive-real functions, including families contradicting the separate irreducibility conjecture. It identifies all base points and exact local lengths for arbitrary rational degree and arbitrary pole configurations, a structural invariant not supplied by the source extremality/reducibility results.
